method_note: Pages fetched via Firecrawl (rendered, not search snippets). Headlines taken from an h1-only re-scrape or from the first visible heading in an extraction of the rendered page; title tag/og:title were used only to explain mismatches. 'verified' = every attribute (organisation, event type, date, consequence) supported by an opened source and >=2 independent opened sources and >=1 headline exact/minor_difference. Entries with a single source cap at partial. Dates seen only in page metadata are listed in problems, not published_on_page.
